messages:
Priya Nair: Quick recap from today's DR game-day + follow-ups. We captured a couple of recurring pain points and some actionable remediation owners. I'll list items and we can refine.
Leo Fernandez: Thanks Priya. Major issue we saw: slow DNS propagation during failback causing 30-90s of traffic stuck in the wrong region.
Riley Chang: Noted. I also observed a backup verification gap: some incremental snapshots didn't have manifest entries, so restores required manual reconciliation.
oncall-bot: Postmortem checklist template created: /ops/playbooks/postmortem-template.md
Priya Nair: Draft action list below. Please reply with owner + ETA.
A) Multi-region routing: add DNS TTL and ALB/cidrs checklist; automate pre-failback warmup. owner: (open) ETA: (open)
B) BGP session tuning and failback rollback steps; include automated smoke test. owner: Leo Fernandez ETA: 2024-11-02
C) Backup manifest verification job (compare S3 manifests -> snapshot ids) + alerting. owner: Riley Chang ETA: 2024-11-05
D) Restore runbook: explicit PV rehydrate flow + quick validation commands. owner: Support Engineer ETA: 2024-11-01
E) Game-day owners rota + playbook drill schedule (6 week cadence). owner: Priya Nair ETA: 2024-11-08
Leo Fernandez: I'll take item B. Plan: reduce BGP hold-time from 120s -> 40s for DR peers, add canary test in staging, and add rollback steps with commands.
Riley Chang: I'll own C. Implementation plan: lambda job in infra CI that validates manifests, runs a dry-restore check (metadata only), and POSTS failures into #incidents. Add PD if >1 failure/day.
Support Engineer: I'll update the restore runbook with concrete commands and validation steps. I'll include a 'fast-path' partial restore section.
Priya Nair: Two process notes: 1) Please open PRs in runbooks repo and tag with postmortem/2024-dr-game-day. 2) I'll run an owners roll call next Wed 09:00 PT to confirm PRs and test plans.
Leo Fernandez: Adding test matrix to the PR: BGP hold 120/60/40, simulated 250ms cross-region RTT, and DNS TTLs 60/30/10. Canary run scheduled 2024-10-30.
Riley Chang: Backup manifest job will be added to infra CI and will emit metric infra.backup.manifest.failures; create alert threshold at >=1 failure/24h. ETA updated to 2024-11-04.
Priya Nair: Note for multi-region routing (item A): add AB test for ALB weights during failback and a pre-warm step to prime KV caches in target region. Who can propose owner for A?
Support Engineer: I'll help draft the runbook content for PV rehydrate and the read-verify checks. Also drafting status blurb for customers in case of visible failback blips.
Leo Fernandez: I'll help with A's network checklist items (ALB, DNS, route53 health-checks) but prefer someone from network infra to be primary.
Riley Chang: Suggest owner assign to "net-ops" for A and leave me as secondary for automation.
Priya Nair: OK assigning A -> net-ops (owner), Riley Chang (automation backup). Target for A: 2024-11-07.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: owners rollcall on 2024-10-30 16:00 UTC
Priya Nair: Great. Action items summary (final):
- A: Multi-region routing checklist & pre-warm 12 owner: net-ops (primary), Riley Chang (secondary) 12 ETA: 2024-11-07
- B: BGP tuning + rollback + canary owner: Leo Fernandez ETA: 2024-11-02
- C: Backup manifest verification job + alerts owner: Riley Chang ETA: 2024-11-04
- D: Restore runbook PV rehydrate + validation owner: Support Engineer ETA: 2024-11-01
- E: Game-day cadence + rotation owner: Priya Nair ETA: 2024-11-08
Priya Nair: Please drop a :white_check_mark: once PRs are open and :rocket: once merged + tests green. I'll close this thread once everything is merged and canary/test runs are green.
Leo Fernandez: :white_check_mark:
Riley Chang: :white_check_mark:
Support Engineer: :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: Thanks everyone. Filing follow-up board items in JIRA after this. If you hit blockers DM me.
